description: Draw shapes on PDF pages: rectangles (filled or outlined), lines, and circles/ellipses. Useful for annotations, diagrams, or marking up documents.

borderColor.description: Border color for rectangles (if different from fill)

filled.description: Fill the shape (default: false, outline only)

height.description: Height (rect/ellipse) or end Y for line

width.description: Width (rect/ellipse) or end X for line

x.description: X position (left edge for rect/ellipse, start X for line)

y.description: Y position (bottom edge for rect/ellipse, start Y for line)

name: pdf_draw
